svg.title: Val Ark: The constellation
svg.desc: A star chart. The brightest star is the Ark, with one data disk. Lines join it to the machines around it: a syncing peer (Syncthing copies models and content, P2P), a GPU machine (runs the models over an NFS export), any laptop (static pages from a file share), and its own source (a bundle and bootstrap.sh, which it copies itself). From that source a new machine installs with curl bootstrap.sh, offline, and becomes another Ark, which fills up when it is online. No internet between them.

g.text: fills up when it is online
